_comment: Canonical listing store. Every entry under `listings` was read this run from a live Coldwell Banker IDX detail page carrying the MetroList feed (status pill, MLS number, amenity table). Search-engine snippets are still not an acceptable source of status - see README 'Verification gate'.

source.name: Coldwell Banker IDX (MetroList / El Dorado County)
source.method: Crawled every active listing page for the three target cities plus their ZIP codes (95682, 95672, 95667), then read each candidate's detail page for lot size and pool from the MLS amenity table. 300 listings in the target cities, 57 clearing beds/baths/price, 9 clearing every criterion.
source.note: Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com, Trulia, Movoto and Homes.com all bot-block this container (CloudFront 403 / 429) even though egress is now open. The Coldwell Banker IDX serves the same MetroList data with structured JSON-LD and does not block.

dataQuality.note: Status, price, bed/bath, lot acreage and pool for every listing below were read from that listing's own live IDX detail page on 2026-08-29, not inferred from search text.

listings.description: Discover the property 6881 Sagittarius Drive, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Crafted as the builder's own residence, this extraordinary European Country-inspired estate was designed without compromise. From its commanding setting on 40 acres with sweeping Sierra foothill views and timeless architectural details, every aspect of the property reflects quality and enduring elegance. From the moment you arrive, the home makes a striking impression, thoughtfully designed to frame a dramatic sightline through the grand entry and expansive rear windows to the rolling hills and panoramic vistas beyond. Upon entering, the soaring ceilings, custom finishes, and walls of windows create a warm, yet elegant atmosphere filled with natural light. The thoughtfully designed kitchen features granite countertops, custom cabinetry, a center island, double warming ovens, premium appliances, a walk-in pantry and picturesque views that elevate everyday living. Multiple living and dining spaces provide exceptional flexibility for entertaining, while the dedicated movie theater room brings the cinematic experience to the comfort of home. The spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat with balcony access, breathtaking views on the first floor, a spa-inspired bathroom, oversized walk-in shower, soaking tub and expansive vanity area. Two additional ensuite bedrooms offer comfort and privacy for guests or multigenerational living. 22KW Whole House Generator. Step outside to your private resort-style backyard with an artistic hand carved rock, saltwater pool specially designed to mimic local river watering holes with a rock waterfall, surrounded by blooming flowers, mature landscaping and several fruit trees creating a peaceful and picturesque retreat. Expansive outdoor entertaining areas overlook majestic oak trees and the surrounding countryside, providing the perfect setting for both quiet relaxation and memorable gatherings. Additional highlights include a 3-car drive-through garage, approximately 1,500 square feet of potential ADU or multigenerational living space on the lower level and endless opportunities for recreation, horses, vineyards or creating the ultimate private estate. This is a rare opportunity to own a custom luxury residence where timeless architecture, exceptional craftsmanship, panoramic views and peaceful acreage come together just minutes from historic Placerville, shopping, dining and convenient access to Sacramento, Lake Tahoe, and the Bay Area.

listings.description: Discover the property 4071 Voyager Way, Shingle Springs, CA 95682 for sale. Escape the hustle and bustle and discover your own private retreat in Shingle Springs. Set on approximately 5 private acres with sweeping hillside views, this single-story custom home offers over 3,000 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space with 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths and an impressive 4-car garage. The outdoor setting is where this property truly shines. A stunning infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa overlook the surrounding hills, creating a spectacular backdrop for relaxing and entertaining. Expansive travertine surrounds the pool, complemented by a dedicated outdoor shower and bathroom for added convenience. At the heart of the home is a spacious chef's kitchen featuring granite countertops and generous prep and gathering space. Engineered wood flooring, a gas fireplace, Andersen dual-pane windows and a whole-house fan add warmth, comfort and efficiency throughout. The flexible floor plan includes a separate living area with its own bedroom, full bathroom, private entrance and gated outdoor spaceideal for guest accommodations, a private office, studio or additional living space. Beyond the main residence, an approximately 20' x 30' detached workshop with a roll-up door and dedicated driveway offers exceptional space for projects, hobbies, equipment or storage. The 4-car garage provides even more room for vehicles and recreational gear. Additional property features include owned solar, a generator, reverse-osmosis system, well, septic, greenhouse and extensive drip irrigation. Private and peaceful yet conveniently located near Highway 50, Placerville and El Dorado Hills, this special property offers an incredible combination of single-story living, acreage, flexible spaces and resort-style outdoor amenities. From afternoons by the pool to evenings taking in the hillside views, this is a place designed to slow down, spread out and enjoy the surroundings.

listings.description: Discover the property 3538 Wildwood Lane, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Welcome to a property that doesn't ask you to choose between a home, a retreat, and country living - you get all three. Set among the Placerville foothills, 3538 Wildwood Lane is a place to swim, garden, gather and spread out. The two-story main home offers a private ground-level guest suite with its own entrance and full bath, plus a two-car garage and full basement access. Upstairs, the living spaces flow into an open-concept family room, dining area and kitchen. Two bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath, while the primary suite features a soaking tub beneath the window, walk-in shower with waterfall-inspired stone mosaic, and attached laundry room. A detached 2-bedroom, 1-bath guest cottage with kitchenette and mountain views creates even more possibilities for guests, extended family or separate living space. Beyond the homes, the property offers the kind of space that makes foothill living so appealing-swim, garden, grow your own food, raise chickens, or simply enjoy having room around you. A pool and outdoor shower, two greenhouses, veggie beds, a large chicken coop, irrigation, abundant fruit and nut trees, and a basic pool house are already in place. With a newer roof and owned solar as well, this is more than a home-it's a property with room to live, grow, gather, and make it your own. Enjoy the perfect balance of privacy and convenience, just 1.6 miles (approximately 3 minutes) from Highway 50, 6.4 miles (approximately 14 minutes) from historic Downtown Placerville, and within approximately 15 minutes of major shopping and services, including Costco, Home Depot, Safeway, and Raley's. A rare opportunity to enjoy serenity, nature, and the best of foothill living.

listings.description: Discover the property 1234 Rising Hill W Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Discover the perfect blend of serenity and opportunity with this exceptional Placerville estate. Situated on a total of 2.69 acres comprised of a 1.39-acre primary parcel and an additional, flat 1.3-acre parcel this property offers unparalleled potential and room to grow in one of the area's finest neighborhoods. The heart of the home is a kitchen built for both utility and connection, featuring ample, easily accessible storage and a window above the primary sink that perfectly frames the arrival of family and guests. A convenient passthrough connects the kitchen to the dining room, which opens seamlessly into a spacious living area. Bathed in natural light from abundant windows and skylights, this space invites the native beauty of the outdoors inside. The main level offers effortless living, while the upstairs primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat. Wake up to serene views and step directly onto your private balcony deck overlooking the pool and barn area. For added convenience, a dedicated utility and laundry room is situated perfectly between the kitchen and the garage. The backyard is your own private getaway. Dive into the gorgeous, inground pool, complete with natural rock features and lush vegetation that create an atmosphere of total seclusion. Whether you're hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet evenings, the multiple decksincluding direct access from the bedroomsmake indoor-outdoor living a breeze. Out back, a substantial barn stands ready for your projects or storage needs, complemented by a massive double carport and ample driveway parking. Nestled in a quiet, natural setting, this home puts you close to town while surrounding you with the quiet, native beauty that makes Placerville special. This is truly a rare opportunity to own a property that combines established excellence with immense potential for expansion. Schedule your visit to see the possibilities firsthand! https://photos.app.goo.gl/KBbpbysn3RFFM7BT8

listings.description: Discover the property 3565 Farview Court, Rescue, CA 95672 for sale. Perched at the end of a private court on its own private road, this fully remodeled custom hilltop estate offers breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views stretching across Folsom Lake, Bass Lake, the Sutter Buttes, Sierras and sparkling city lights. Designed to embrace its spectacular surroundings, every room showcases incredible vistas through windows and private sliding glass doors. This exceptional home offers 4-6 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, with nearly every bedroom featuring direct access to brand-new-multi-level balconies, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. The completely remodeled kitchen features new appliances and opens to light-filled living spaces finished new wood flooring, doors, baseboards, lighting and premium thoughtful finishes throughout. Enjoy the convenience of a fully integrated smart home system controlled by Aqua link, making it easy to manage your home's features from anywhere. The attached guest house, pool house, or private office provides outstanding flexibility with a full bathroom, space for a future kitchenette, storage area and beautiful views overlooking the pool and dramatic granite outcroppings- ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or working from home. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped grounds featuring a fully fenced perimeter, providing privacy and security for pets and children. Relax by the pool equipped with a new Aztec solar heating system, or retreat to the newly built Eagle's Nest viewing deck-the perfect place to enjoy sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, or peaceful evenings under the stars. A detached storage shed offers additional space for workshop, hobby room, or extra storage. Car enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers will appreciate 3-car garage, 2 parking areas with convenient access, and room to allow for RV and boat parking if desired. There is also ample space to build an additional dwelling unit (ADU) if desired. Despite its private mountaintop setting, the remarkable property is just minutes from Highway 50, El Dorado hills, Folsom, shopping, dining, coffee shops, and everyday conveniences. Offering unmatched privacy luxurious updates, incredible flexibility, and unforgettable views in every direction, this is a rare opportunity to own one of the area's most extraordinary homes.

listings.description: Discover the property 2565 Stagecoach Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Nestled on a stunning 5-acre homesite in the prestigious gated community of Greenstone Country, this custom estate blends luxury, privacy, and outdoor recreation. Surrounded by mature oak trees and rock outcroppings, the approximately 3,885 sq. ft. home is designed for comfortable living and entertaining. The spacious floorplan offers 5-6 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a 4-car garage, and a detached 2-car carport. Three bedrooms are located on the main level, while upstairs features the private primary suite with a balcony, fireplace, built-in storage and bar area, oversized walk-in closet with hidden storage, and two additional bedrooms. The open-concept living area showcases Andersen wood-framed windows and patio doors, custom built-ins, and a soaring fireplace with raised hearth. The country kitchen is equipped with a new downdraft cooktop and also built in microwave/oven, dishwasher, farmhouse style sink, and a generous walk-in pantry. Hardwood and tile flooring, and brand-new carpet. Ceiling fans, and a large laundry/mud room add comfort and convenience. Outdoor amenities include a wraparound covered front porch, expansive back deck, fenced pool with waterfall, and covered pergola. The property also features a small olive orchard, fenced garden area with two storage sheds, and a Tuff Shed located nearby the pool area. Residents enjoy Greenstone Country's exceptional amenities, including "The Barn" neighborhood gathering venue, riding arena, miles of horseback riding and hiking trails, fishing ponds, tennis courts, and two playgrounds. This remarkable property offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy refined country living in one of the region's most sought-after equestrian communities!
